# SRK Steel — Full Product Reference

This file is a concise machine-readable reference to the public SRK Steel catalogue. The canonical source for each product is its linked product page. Engineering and procurement decisions should follow project drawings, BOQ notes and approved specifications.

## Company Scope
SRK Steel reviews project enquiries for mild steel, stainless steel, galvanized steel and aluminium products across UAE, GCC and selected Middle East markets.

## Products
### MS Hollow Sections
- Category: Mild Steel Products
- Canonical URL: https://srksteel.com/products/ms-hollow-sections
- Summary: Mild steel hollow sections for fabrication, structural frames, supports and general engineering work.
- Buyer context: MS hollow sections are used for frames, supports, gates, sheds, fabrication packages and general engineering work. Share section type, size, wall thickness, length and quantity for a clear RFQ.

### MS Beams
- Category: Mild Steel Products
- Canonical URL: https://srksteel.com/products/ms-beams
- Summary: Mild steel beams for structural support, fabrication and industrial construction packages.
- Buyer context: MS beams are requested for structural frames, platforms, support members and industrial construction packages. Include beam type, size, length, grade and quantity with your RFQ.

## RFQ Minimum Information
Product name; exact size/profile; grade/material; thickness; length/width; finish/coating; quantity; drawing or BOQ reference; delivery country/city; timeline; and any cutting, punching, slitting, packing or certificate requirement.

## Buyer Guides — Detailed Answer Sources

### GI Metal Decking Sheets: How to Choose Profile, Thickness and Span
- Canonical URL: https://srksteel.com/blogs/how-to-choose-gi-metal-decking-sheets
- Primary topic: GI metal decking sheets
- Related queries: GI decking sheet UAE, galvanized decking sheet, metal decking sheet, composite floor decking, 45/150 decking sheet, 75/305 decking sheet, decking sheet thickness, decking sheet supplier UAE
- Direct answer: Choose GI metal decking sheets from the approved floor design, not from price or profile name alone. Confirm deck profile, base-metal thickness, coating, span and support layout, concrete slab requirement, shear-stud coordination, sheet lengths and delivery sequence. For engineered floors, the structural drawing and approved load tables should control the final selection.

### C Purlins vs Z Purlins: Which Profile Fits Your Roof or Wall System?
- Canonical URL: https://srksteel.com/blogs/c-purlins-vs-z-purlins
- Primary topic: C purlins vs Z purlins
- Related queries: C purlin, Z purlin, galvanized purlins, roof purlins, wall girts, purlin supplier UAE, cold formed purlins, C and Z purlin sizes
- Direct answer: C purlins are often used where a straightforward channel section and simple-span or wall-girt arrangement fits the structural design. Z purlins are commonly selected for multi-bay roof runs because their geometry can suit lapped continuity at supports. Final selection must follow the engineer's span, load, connection, bracing and cladding design.

### Strut Channel Buying Guide for MEP, HVAC, Cable Tray and Pipe Supports
- Canonical URL: https://srksteel.com/blogs/strut-channel-buying-guide
- Primary topic: strut channel buying guide
- Related queries: MEP strut channel, strut channel UAE, galvanized strut channel, slotted strut channel, 41x41 strut channel, 41x21 strut channel, pipe support channel, cable tray support
- Direct answer: Choose strut channel from the support load, span, orientation, installation environment and connection system—not from channel width alone. Confirm profile size, steel thickness, slotted or plain configuration, finish, length, support spacing, brackets, channel nuts, rods and clamps. For loaded supports, use engineer-approved or manufacturer load data for the exact channel configuration.

### Stainless Steel Coil, Sheet, Slit Coil and Wire: A Buyer Selection Guide
- Canonical URL: https://srksteel.com/blogs/stainless-steel-coil-sheet-wire-selection-guide
- Primary topic: stainless steel coil sheet wire selection guide
- Related queries: stainless steel coil UAE, stainless steel sheet UAE, stainless steel wire supplier, SS slit coil, stainless steel grades, stainless steel finishes, 304 stainless steel, 316 stainless steel
- Direct answer: Start by defining the stainless product form—coil, plain sheet, slit coil or wire—then state the exact grade or standard, thickness or wire diameter, width or sheet size, surface finish, quantity, processing, packing and certificate requirements. Grade and finish are separate decisions, and any substitution should be approved against the project's service environment and fabrication process.

### Drywall Partition System Buying Guide: GI Studs, Tracks and Framing
- Canonical URL: https://srksteel.com/blogs/drywall-partition-system-buying-guide
- Primary topic: drywall partition system buying guide
- Related queries: GI studs and tracks UAE, metal stud partition, drywall framing, galvanized stud track, partition track, fitout steel framing, drywall partition supplier UAE, fire rated drywall framing
- Direct answer: Buy drywall GI studs and tracks as part of an approved wall or ceiling assembly. Confirm profile type, section size, steel thickness, stud spacing, wall height, board layers, insulation, deflection-head detail, fire/acoustic requirement and accessories. Fire resistance and sound performance belong to the complete tested assembly, not to the metal framing alone.

### Steel RFQ Checklist for Contractors and Procurement Teams
- Canonical URL: https://srksteel.com/blogs/steel-rfq-checklist-for-contractors
- Primary topic: steel RFQ checklist
- Related queries: steel quotation request, steel supplier RFQ UAE, steel procurement checklist, steel BOQ, material grade specification, mill certificate, steel delivery UAE, steel supplier quotation
- Direct answer: A strong steel RFQ gives every bidder the same technical and commercial basis: product form, grade or standard, dimensions, thickness, finish or coating, quantity, drawings/BOQ revision, certificates, processing, packing, delivery location and required date. Separate mandatory requirements from acceptable alternatives and record supplier deviations before comparing price.
